verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a payments platform with an API, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a Rainforest CLI. The API keys, OpenAPI spec, embedded components, Zapier and llms.txt are related developer surfaces, not a command-line tool, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
